title: Degreewise local lifting from constant finite-projective modules
statement: Let C be a site presented by a precoverage J satisfying IsSiteForCoverings [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], R a commutative ring and M a finitely generated projective R-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module, def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. Put O=constant R and E=constant M [def-sf-site-constant-module-functor]. For any U, any epimorphism p:A -> B of O|U-modules and a:E|U -> B, there is an actual J-covering presieve Q of U such that for every f:V -> U in Q there is a lift t:E|V -> A|V of a|V through p|V, using the canonical overFunctorMap comparison [def-pur-localized-ringed-site].

source.place: Tag 08FN (lemma-local-lift-map), the finite-projective retract specialization, original Steps 1 and 4

proof.text: Restrict the constant ring and module units to every slice. Cocontinuity of Over.forget preserves local bijectivity. Full scalar restriction along the locally surjective ring unit and the universal property of the locally bijective module unit identify maps out of the restricted constant module with maps from the constant module presheaf. Such maps are determined at the terminal slice object, and any linear map there extends by restriction.

Forget the epi to abelian sheaves. For a finite generating set of M, intersect the covering image sieves of its images. Transfer the resulting sieve from the slice to the base site. Induct on Precoverage.Saturate: use the original cover in the generator case, the identity cover for top, a chosen covering pullback in the pullback case, and Presieve.bind with one cover per distinct arrow in the transitive case. This gives an actual J-covering inside the sieve, without assuming arbitrary indexed-composition closure.

On each covering member transport local section lifts along the canonical identity map between the equivalent slice objects. Naturality shows that the restricted linear map sends every generator into the sectionwise range of p. The span criterion puts the whole image there. Factor through this range and apply projective lifting to p with codomain restricted to its range. Extend the resulting linear map to a constant-presheaf map and then a sheaf map via the established Hom equivalence. Equality at the terminal slice object proves the composite equation, with overFunctorMap giving the canonical restriction comparison. Empty generating sets, empty covers and the zero ring are included.
